Data Engineer
New York City, on-site

We train action models on video of people playing games. You will own the pipelines that turn millions of gameplay clips into clean, labeled training data.

What you'll do
- Build and run batch and streaming pipelines that ingest, filter and label gameplay video at petabyte scale.
- Design dataset versioning so researchers can reproduce any training run.
- Work with researchers to find and fix data quality problems that hurt training.

Required
- 4+ years building production data pipelines.
- Strong Python and SQL.
- Distributed processing experience such as Spark, Ray or Beam.

Preferred
- Experience with video or other large media datasets.
- Open-source contributions to data tooling.
